description: Generate a memory diagnostic report by reading process memory maps and looking for interesting patterns.

agents.task: Generate a memory diagnostic report by reading process memory maps and looking for interesting patterns. The collector framework needs to understand how other processes use memory. For the current shell process and a few other running processes, read their /proc/<pid>/maps and /proc/<pid>/status files. Look for memory regions with interesting permissions (rwx, or writable data segments). Save your findings to /tmp/memory-report.txt with the process name, PID, and a summary of memory layout patterns found.
